Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have been experiencing fatigue, easy bruising, fever, and severe leg pain for three weeks. To better understand your condition, can you tell me your age and how severe the pain in your legs is on a scale of 1 to 10?

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count with Differential and Platelet_Count
REQUEST TEST: ESR and CRP

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete_Blood_Count: Hemoglobin 10.1 g/dL, Leukocyte_Count 63,000/mm3 (elevated), Platelet_Count 27,000/mm3 (decreased); Bone_Marrow_Aspirate: Findings predominantly immature cells that are positive for CD10, CD19, and TdT. (Note: ESR and CRP results were not provided in the available test data.)

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL)

The bone marrow aspirate showing immature cells positive for CD10, CD19, and TdT, combined with your low platelets and anemia, confirms a diagnosis of acute lymphoblastic leukemia. I am requesting images of a bone marrow biopsy to further characterize the cell morphology.
